newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas in talks to sell 11 planes.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas in talks to sell 11 planes.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp's Douglas Aircraft Co said Thursday it is in negotiations with Central Leasing of Taiwan for the potential sale of 11 new and used twin-jet aircraft.
The new MD-90 twin-jets, which are part of the new aircraft order, would be from previously unsold 1997 and 1998 production, the company said.
Final negotiations will be subject to the completion of a new joint venture, finalization of significant terms, and raising of the necessary capital, McDonnell Douglas said.
Taiwan's Central Leasing Co also said on Thursday it would team up with McDonnell Douglas to start a $200 million global leasing firm to tackle aircraft shortages in China.
The transaction also is subject to McDonnell Douglas obtaining lessees for some of the aircraft, which McDonnell Douglas has not yet been able to identify.
McDonnell Douglas shares were unchanged at 69-3/4 Thursday.
